description:
Test one 3D node at a candidate world position and rotation without moving it: overlaps, grounded state and the gap to the floor. Changes nothing. Then place it with summer_set_prop or summer_snap_to_surface.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/test-placement"}

candidateGlobalPosition.description: Candidate global/world position as [x, y, z].

candidateGlobalRotationDegrees.description: Candidate global/world Euler rotation in degrees as [x, y, z]; current global scale is preserved.

collideWithAreas.description: Include Area3D objects as placement obstacles/support candidates.

collisionMask.description: Godot 3D physics layers included in overlap and floor queries.

groundTolerance.description: Absolute floor-gap tolerance used to classify grounded support.

margin.description: Physics shape-intersection margin; only an exact physics support collider+shape contact is excluded from overlaps.

maxFloorDistance.description: Maximum world-space distance searched below the candidate footprint; range 0.001..1000.

scenePath.description: Exact scene path containing the subject, e.g. 'res://levels/workshop.tscn'.

subjectPath.description: Exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './World/Crate'.

name: summer_test_placement
title: Test a placement without moving
